title: Microsoft 365 admin center: pay for Copilot Chat from prepaid capacity packs alone
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documents standalone prepaid policies, their licensing, the service interruption when credits run out, and the controls shown. The allocation API is supported despite the automatic pre-check; minor corrections should name its deciding request-body fields and remove checklist instructions for controls absent from the table.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans prepaid capacity as the sole billing method for supported Copilot experiences, without pay-as-you-go charges.
claims.quote: Use a prepaid capacity pack as the sole billing method for supported Copilot experiences. Admins can configure billing policies with prepaid capacity such that usage for users in the policy is deducted exclusively from prepaid capacity credits, with no pay as you go charges.

claims.claim: PUT /licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 sets the TenantPool enforcement rule for MCSMessages.
claims.quote:
$apiVersion = "2024-10-01"
entitlementId = "MCSMessages"
@{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false }
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"
claims.fix: Keep the call unchanged. Replace the first sentence of controls[2].note with: 'The request body sets allocatedEntitlements[].enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool and enabled true or false for entitlementId MCSMessages.' These fields are shown at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/programmability-tutorial-manage-copilot-credit-allocations.

claims.claim: Capacity overages offers both tenant-capacity draw and pay-as-you-go billing options, and administrators may select one or both.
claims.quote:
Under Capacity overages, select the options for what happens when capacity reaches zero. You can choose one or both of the following options:
- Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.
- Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan.

claims.quote: Select Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan to let the environment continue usage through the selected billing plan.

claims.claim: An environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits when no overage source is enabled.
claims.quote: If no overage source is enabled, the environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits. Experiences that require credits can stop working after that allocation is exhausted.
